description: Introduction and overview of the Hudson Hornet (1951-1954): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Hudson Hornet dominated early NASCAR with its 'step-down' chassis — the floor sat inside the frame rails, giving a low center of gravity. With Twin H-Power dual carbs, Hornets won 27 of 34 NASCAR races in 1952. The Hornet made Hudson a giant-killer before the AMC merger.
